guard_contract.ordering: existing previous-realized-action velocity clamp, then measured-actual-centered absolute pitch-target clamp
guard_contract.state_feedback: previous_action_out must equal the guarded continuous_actions output
guard_contract.reachable_intersection: contract chains from home and requires both velocity and absolute guard constraints on every generated step

contract_before_behavior: archive and source member hashes exact
all source nodes and initializers unchanged
only appended guard nodes and guard constants
pitch sent target remains within measured actual plus or minus frozen margin
all output deltas remain within existing per-joint velocity limits on reachable chained inputs
state output equals guarded action exactly

advance_rule.combination: same margin and tail arm must pass unchanged gate at both half and final source checkpoints
advance_rule.gate: all six cells present, 600 ticks, duration complete, bilateral gait, zero saturation, zero measured rate excess, maximum pitch-chain tracking p95 <= 0.20 rad, and PASS_CANDIDATE_SIM_GATE
